text: Вдячний делегації Конгресу Америки – Роджеру Вікеру, Кевіну Крамеру, Марку Вісі та Дену Креншоу – за те, що сьогодні поруч з нашими людьми під час фактично безперервних російських атак. Росія не отримує того, що хотіла на полі бою, і намагається компенсувати це ескалацією. Протягом всього часу нашої зустрічі у Києві тривала повітряна тривога через загрозу реактивних «шахедів». Тільки у столиці і тільки від початку цього місяця росіяни такими дронами пошкодили дві школи, були удари по мостах, енергетиці, іншій критичній інфраструктурі. Захиститися від цього терору можна тільки спільно, і ми обговорили, яким чином Сполучені Штати можуть допомогти зберегти життя. Звісно, ми розраховуємо, що буде реалізовано закон Ліндсі Грема. Це питання політичної волі, і зараз важливо проявити лідерство й повністю обмежити фінансові потоки для російської воєнної машини. Ми також обговорили інші необхідні кроки, зокрема прискорення ліцензування виробництва ракет до «петріотів». Україна готова не просто виробляти перехоплювачі балістики для себе, а посилити спільним виробництвом Америку та союзників. Дякую Сполученим Штатам за незмінну підтримку.

text: Відвідав бійців легендарної бригади “Рубіж”. Для мене велика честь особисто поспілкуватися і потиснути руку воїнам, які втримали Київщину і зараз тримають Україну. Перш за все, передав від себе і небайдужого бізнесу необхідне обладнання, яке допоможе бригаді виконувати поставлені завдання. Для нас, для всіх громадян тут не просто важливо підтримувати військо. Це наш обов’язок. Принагідно обговорили подальшу співпрацю. Зафіксував потреби бійців, спільно сформували ті напрямки, де може включитись обласна адміністрація, де можемо залучити меценатський і волонтерський ресурс. Будемо об’єднувати зусилля для посилення обороноздатності наших військових. Це дуже актуально, адже бригада зараз виконує завдання на найскладніших ділянках фронту. Подякував бійцям за звитягу в 2022 році, коли тут, в Гостомелі, “Рубіж” був серед тих, хто не дав ворогу дійти до столиці і відкинув окупанта з Київщини. Пишаюсь, що в нашій команді полковник Артем Ілюхін, якому випала нагода очолювати бригаду деякий час тому. Низький уклін всім, хто боронить нашу державу. Вічна пам’ять тим, хто в цій боротьбі віддав найдорожче. Слава Україні!

text: На пасажирських станціях Київщини починаємо встановлювати модульні укриття. Сьогодні відвідав такий об’єкт на залізничній станції у Глевасі. Модульне укриття слугує як тимчасова захисна споруда для безпеки пасажирів та персоналу станції. Воно сертифіковане та відповідає необхідним вимогам. Місткість такого об’єкту - 29 осіб. Завдяки швидкому розгортанню та модульній конструкції, такі укриття досить швидко встановити. Ці об’єкти - оперативний захід для посилення безпеки залізничних перевезень там, де є дефіцит капітальних захисних споруд. Що особливо важливо коли ворог атакує залізничну інфраструктуру. Також триває встановлення таких укриттів на залізничних платформах у Вишневому та Броварах. Вони будуть готові найближчим часом. Разом з УЗ та громадами області спільно працюємо над масштабуванням цього проєкту, оскільки є значний запит на захисні споруди на низці інших вокзалів та залізничних станцій.
author: Kyiv Oblast Administration

text: Зустрівся з міністром оборони Естонії Мартіном Херемом. Фактично під час усіх контактів з партнерами обговорюємо, як посилити захист українського неба. Естонія активно допомагає в цьому напрямі. Ми вдячні за кожен оборонний пакет і підтримку програми PURL, яка дозволяє нам отримувати перехоплювачі балістики. Сьогодні обговорили можливості нових внесків, а також пошук додаткового фінансування на закупівлю ППО. Drone Deal, яку наші країни підписали, дозволяє експортувати українську зброю до Естонії. Таким чином Естонія може отримати перевірену зброю, а Україна – додаткові кошти для захисту. Домовилися, що команди оперативно попрацюють над наповненням такого експортного пакету. Вдячний також Естонії за надійну підтримку на нашому шляху до ЄС.
author: Kyiv Oblast Administration

text: ‼️ 🇷🇺 🛰 Россия может нарушить работу Starlink, даже не уничтожая спутники, — Reuters ▪️ Российские военные спутники отрабатывают манёвры, которые потенциально могут использоваться против крупных коммерческих спутниковых группировок, включая Starlink, заявил агентству командующий Космическим командованием Германии генерал-майор Михаэль Траут. ▪️ По его словам, в мае четыре российских военных спутника маневрировали рядом с аппаратом финской компании ICEYE, предоставляющей разведывательные снимки США и их союзникам, включая Украину. ▪️ Для нарушения работы Starlink необязательно сбивать спутники. Российские аппараты могут создавать препятствия на их орбитальных траекториях, вынуждая уклоняться и расходовать топливо. Это потенциально сократит срок службы спутников и ухудшит качество связи. ▪️ Траут считает, что прямая атака на Starlink стала бы серьёзной эскалацией, однако Москва может прибегнуть к менее очевидным способам воздействия на спутниковую сеть. ⚠️ Подписаться на RV: MAX | t.me/RVvoenkor

author: Julian Borger and Rachel Savage

The quake hit along the southern coast of the country, the USGS said. It was centered near the southern tip of the Central American country, about 14km (9 miles) south-west of the remote community of Pitaloza Arriba, the USGS said. The Institute of Geosciences of the University of Panama said the quake struck at just before 1pm local time near the southern town of Tonosí. title: Vance casts doubt on whether execution livestream ‘is actually going to happen’ as more Republicans join outcry – US politics live
text: 14.48 EDT Vance says he's doesn't know if execution live stream 'is actually going to happen' Vice-President JD Vance said he didn’t know if the decision to livestream the execution of Nidal Hasan, that defense secretary Pete Hegseth announced would take place on 3 December in front of a firing squad, “is actually going to happen” . Speaking to reporters on Friday, Vance was asked about how he squares his Christian faith with the Pentagon’s decision to broadcast the execution – for the first time in history. “First of all, I’ve seen these announcements. I don’t know that that’s actually going to happen,” Vance said. “What I try to remind people is, look, this is a guy who committed, in my view, the worst terrorist attack on American soil outside of 9/11 … So whatever the controversy is about the method of the execution, I hope that people don’t forget that this is a guy who brutally murdered a lot of innocent people.” However, Vance said that if the decision is made to live stream Hasan’s execution, he was “not going to be watching it”.

text: 📆 #ВэтотДень в Московском Кремле был создан Пушечный приказ – центральное военное учреждение XVI–XVII веков. Он объединил все существовавшие в крупных городах Пушечные избы и московский Пушечный двор. Основные функции Пушечного приказа: ▫️ изготовление, распределение и учёт артиллерийских орудий и боеприпасов; ▫️ управление Пушечным двором, Гранатным двором и казёнными пороховыми мельницами; ▫️ контроль состояния крепостных укреплений в большинстве городов России; ▫️ наблюдение за состоянием оборонительных преград. 📌 Пушечный приказ управлялся боярином и двумя дьяками, делился на городовой, засечный и денежный столы. title: Trump says he’s reached a deal with Putin to supply Russian diesel to U.S. and global markets. Zelensky calls it ‘an investment in a war that must be ended, not prolonged.’
text: U.S. President Donald Trump said he had reached a deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin to supply Russian diesel fuel to U.S. and global markets. Trump said they reached the agreement during “highly successful” talks by phone. Russia agreed to supply more than 300,000 metric tons of diesel fuel to U.S. and global markets as soon as possible, Trump said. It will supply another 500,000 metric tons in November and 1 million metric tons “immediately thereafter.” “Based on the condition of their Diesel Refineries,” Moscow could also supply another 3 million metric tons of diesel “within a short period of time,” Trump said. Trump’s announcement came as the U.S. Treasury Department issued a temporary license allowing Russian diesel fuel to be supplied to the global market until April 7, 2027. “Thanks to our total control of the Strait of Hormuz, and this great announcement on Russian Energy, Diesel Prices for Americans and, indeed, the World, will be COMING DOWN, IN RECORD NUMBERS, AND FAST!” Trump said. title: Montenegro Expels Founder of Russian Pro-War Blog Rybar for 'Security Reasons'
text: Montenegro Expels Founder of Russian Pro-War Blog Rybar for 'Security Reasons' Oct. 9, 2026 Mikhail Zvinchuk. Rutube Montenegro expelled Mikhail Zvinchuk, the founder of the influential Russian pro-war Telegram channel Rybar, and three other Russian nationals on Friday after detaining them in an operation targeting suspected Russian influence activities, police and the country’s National Security Agency said. The agencies said the four could no longer remain in Montenegro “for reasons of national and internal security of the state.” Their statement identified the Russians only by their initials, but a police source confirmed their identities to Reuters. Zvinchuk, a former Russian Defense Ministry press officer, was detained in the Adriatic resort town of Risan along with others including his wife, Rybar creative director Valeria Zvinchuk, local media reported. Security sources told Vijesti that police and the National Security Agency (ANB) carried out the operation to counter “hybrid activities” by Russian information networks. text: In Russian-Occupied Oleshky, Civilians Struggle to Survive as Hunger Deepens By James Beardsworth Oct. 9, 2026 A drone view of Oleshky, Ukraine. 34th Separate Marine Brigade "Borysfen" / facebook.com/34obrmp Lyudmila often has to call her sister about 40 times before the line connects. When she finally gets through, she can barely make out what her sister is saying. "I hear occasional words, sometimes they're incomplete. The main thing is that I hear her voice," Lyudmila, whose name has been changed for safety reasons, told The Moscow Times. A refugee now living in Europe, Lyudmila comes from a village on the Ukrainian-controlled right bank of the Dnipro River in the Kherson region. Her sister lives across the river in the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky, where relentless bombardment has plunged the town into a deepening humanitarian crisis. Conditions in Oleshky have continued to deteriorate since late 2025. Roads leading in and out of the town are heavily mined and badly damaged, leaving its 2,000 remaining residents, including an estimated 50 children, largely cut off from food, water, gas, electricity and medicine, residents and volunteers told The Moscow Times. title: Rosneft Recruits Anti-Aircraft Gun Crews to Defend Samara Refinery Against Ukrainian Drones – Vyorstka
text: Rosneft Recruits Anti-Aircraft Gun Crews to Defend Samara Refinery Against Ukrainian Drones – Vyorstka Oct. 9, 2026 Anti-aircraft self-propelled gun 23-4 Shilka. Russian Defense Ministry State oil giant Rosneft has advertised jobs for anti-aircraft gun and armored vehicle crews to defend a refinery in the southern city of Samara against Ukrainian drones, the exiled news outlet Vyorstka reported Friday. The listings on Russian recruitment website HeadHunter sought personnel to operate Soviet-era anti-aircraft guns and infantry fighting vehicles at the address of Rosneft’s Kuibyshev refinery, the outlet reported. The Kuibyshev refinery, on the Volga River, has been repeatedly targeted since Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022. Applicants’ duties included intercepting aerial targets and keeping armored vehicles stationed at the refinery ready for combat, Vyorstka reported. The advertised monthly compensation totaled 249,000 rubles ($2,938), including salary, regional governor bonuses and military reserve pay. title: Oil Slick Expands Near Sochi After Tanker Fire, Greenpeace Says
text: Oil Slick Expands Near Sochi After Tanker Fire, Greenpeace Says Oct. 9, 2026 Smoke from a burning tanker at sea near Sochi. @exilenova_plus / Telegram An oil slick in the Black Sea near Russia’s resort city of Sochi has expanded following a fire aboard a tanker attacked by sea drones earlier this week, Greenpeace said Friday, a day after authorities reopened beaches and reported no oil contamination. The slick grew from 8 to 25 square kilometers over three days, the environmental group said , citing satellite images from Planet Labs. Greenpeace said the slick extended along the route taken by the Aframax Rio after the attack. Around midday Wednesday, the tanker was near Lazarevskoye, about 50 kilometers from the site of the fire. By Thursday, it was near Tuapse. Environmentalists believe the vessel may be under tow to Novorossiysk. Sochi and the neighboring federal territory of Sirius closed their beaches on Tuesday after the Liberian-flagged tanker caught fire following an attack attributed to Ukrainian sea drones. title: Attack On Europe: Documenting Ukrainian Equipment Losses During The Russian Invasion Of Ukraine - Oryx
text: By Jakub Janovsky , naalsio26 , Aloha , Dan , Kemal , and Alexander Black This list only includes destroyed vehicles and equipment of which photo or videographic evidence is available. Therefore, the amount of equipment destroyed is significantly higher than recorded here. Loitering munitions, civilian-grade drones, civilian vehicles and derelict equipment (including aircraft) are not included in this list. All possible effort has gone into avoiding duplicate entries and discerning the status of equipment between captured or abandoned. Many of the entries listed as 'abandoned' will likely end up captured or destroyed. Similarly, some of the captured equipment might be destroyed if it can't be recovered. When a vehicle is captured and then lost in service with its new owners, it is only added as a loss of the original operator to avoid double listings. When the origin of a piece of equipment can't be established, it's not included in the list. The Soviet flag is used when the equipment in question was produced prior to 1991. title: Zelenskyy denounces Trump’s decision to lift diesel sanctions on Russia as ‘weak’ – US politics live
text: 17.14 EDT Zelenskyy denounces Trump's decision to lift diesel sanctions on Russia as 'weak' Ukraine’s president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, denounced Donald Trump’s decision to suspend sanctions on Russia, to let the US buy diesel fuel from the nation that kills Ukrainian civilians daily, in an interview with Axios on Friday. Zelenskyy, who had traveled to Washington to plead with US lawmakers to pass tougher sanctions on Russia last month, reportedly told Axios on Friday that Trump’s decision, was “not fair and not honest” and “looks like a happy birthday present for Putin”. “It looks absolutely terrible,” he added. Ukraine’s president also criticized Trump’s decision in a statement on social media, in which he wrote: Peace never comes through weakness. Today, representatives of the U.S. Congress were in Kyiv – a bipartisan delegation – and I am grateful to them for visiting Ukraine at such a difficult time. They asked: what is needed to end the war? The answer must be strong. There must be sanctions under the Lindsey Graham bill, there must be support for Ukraine in protecting lives, and there must be pressure on Russia for its war. text: 📆 Еженедельная авторская колонка; ⚡️ Руководителя проекта «Курсы тактической медицины» с позывным «Латыш » ✅ Специально для канала Colonelcassad Синдром терминального состояния при ранениях головы представляет собой критическую степень нарушения жизненно важных функций организма, развивающуюся в результате крайне тяжелого повреждения головного мозга. Данное состояние характеризуется глубоким угнетением сознания вплоть до комы, прогрессирующей сердечно-сосудистой недостаточностью и угасанием дыхательной функции. Патогенетической основой терминального состояния при черепно-мозговых ранениях является прямое разрушение жизненно важных центров ствола мозга, массивная кровопотеря при повреждении синусов твердой мозговой оболочки или нарастающий отек мозга с дислокацией срединных структур и вклинением ствола в большое затылочное отверстие. Клиническая картина терминального состояния при ранениях головы имеет характерные проявления. Кожные покровы приобретают серый или землистый оттенок, губы цианотичны. Раненый находится в состоянии глубокой заторможенности, переходящей в сопор или кому. Пульс определяется только на сонных артериях, частота сердечных сокращений превышает сто сорок ударов

title: Watch: Fleeing Kyiv for the countryside ahead of winter
text: Watch: Fleeing Kyiv for the countryside ahead of winter Watch: Fleeing Kyiv for the countryside ahead of winter Close Kyiv resident Olena Konoplia has decided to move to Ukraine's countryside, as Russian attacks on the city have intensified and the prospect of another cold winter looms. Russia has been targeting Ukraine's power grid leaving locals without electricity and heating, and they will soon face prolonged periods of sub-zero temperatures. title: Russian strikes and approaching winter force some in Kyiv to pack bags and flee
text: Russian strikes and approaching winter force some in Kyiv to pack bags and flee Figure caption, Watch: Olena explains what she cannot live near in order to stay safe By Paul Adams Diplomatic correspondent, in Kyiv Published 9 October 2026 As Russia's attacks on Ukraine's cities intensify and autumn's cooler temperatures hint at another tough winter to come, Ukrainians are wrestling with how to meet the twin challenges ahead: Russian drone and missile strikes and the biting cold. "It was a very difficult winter last year in Kyiv," says mother of two Mariia Shostak, who is now packing her bags and leaving her small flat. With prolonged periods of sub-zero temperatures and frequent power cuts brought about by Russia's attack on the country's power grid, last winter was one of the hardest so far. "There were some days and weeks that were unbearable. I started thinking I'm not going through another winter like this." Mariia is not even waiting for winter. Russia's latest assaults on the capital have forced her hand. "Everything changed in late August and the beginning of September, when Kyiv started being attacked around the clock," she said. text: Montenegro Expels Founder of Russian Pro-War Blog Rybar for 'Security Reasons' Oct. 9, 2026 Mikhail Zvinchuk. text: In Russian-Occupied Oleshky, Civilians Struggle to Survive as Hunger Deepens By James Beardsworth Oct. 9, 2026 A drone view of Oleshky, Ukraine. 34th Separate Marine Brigade "Borysfen" / facebook.com/34obrmp Lyudmila often has to call her sister about 40 times before the line connects. When she finally gets through, she can barely make out what her sister is saying. "I hear occasional words, sometimes they're incomplete. The main thing is that I hear her voice," Lyudmila, whose name has been changed for safety reasons, told The Moscow Times. A refugee now living in Europe, Lyudmila comes from a village on the Ukrainian-controlled right bank of the Dnipro River in the Kherson region. Her sister lives across the river in the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky, where relentless bombardment has plunged the town into a deepening humanitarian crisis. Conditions in Oleshky have continued to deteriorate since late 2025. Roads leading in and out of the town are heavily mined and badly damaged, leaving its 2,000 remaining residents, including an estimated 50 children, largely cut off from food, water, gas, electricity and medicine, residents and volunteers told The Moscow Times. text: Rosneft Recruits Anti-Aircraft Gun Crews to Defend Samara Refinery Against Ukrainian Drones – Vyorstka Oct. 9, 2026 Anti-aircraft self-propelled gun 23-4 Shilka. Russian Defense Ministry State oil giant Rosneft has advertised jobs for anti-aircraft gun and armored vehicle crews to defend a refinery in the southern city of Samara against Ukrainian drones, the exiled news outlet Vyorstka reported Friday. The listings on Russian recruitment website HeadHunter sought personnel to operate Soviet-era anti-aircraft guns and infantry fighting vehicles at the address of Rosneft’s Kuibyshev refinery, the outlet reported. The Kuibyshev refinery, on the Volga River, has been repeatedly targeted since Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022. Applicants’ duties included intercepting aerial targets and keeping armored vehicles stationed at the refinery ready for combat, Vyorstka reported. The advertised monthly compensation totaled 249,000 rubles ($2,938), including salary, regional governor bonuses and military reserve pay. title: Oil Slick Expands Near Sochi After Tanker Fire, Greenpeace Says
text: Oil Slick Expands Near Sochi After Tanker Fire, Greenpeace Says Oct. 9, 2026 Smoke from a burning tanker at sea near Sochi. @exilenova_plus / Telegram An oil slick in the Black Sea near Russia’s resort city of Sochi has expanded following a fire aboard a tanker attacked by sea drones earlier this week, Greenpeace said Friday, a day after authorities reopened beaches and reported no oil contamination. The slick grew from 8 to 25 square kilometers over three days, the environmental group said , citing satellite images from Planet Labs. Greenpeace said the slick extended along the route taken by the Aframax Rio after the attack. Around midday Wednesday, the tanker was near Lazarevskoye, about 50 kilometers from the site of the fire. By Thursday, it was near Tuapse. Environmentalists believe the vessel may be under tow to Novorossiysk. Sochi and the neighboring federal territory of Sirius closed their beaches on Tuesday after the Liberian-flagged tanker caught fire following an attack attributed to Ukrainian sea drones.
